description: Defines the SessionTerminalManager class which manages VS Code terminals for agent sessions, handling creation, display, closure, and cleanup of terminals associated with different agent sessions, including support for parallel mode worktrees and remote sessions.

classes.name: SessionTerminalManager
classes.description: Manages VS Code terminals for agent sessions, including creation, display, and cleanup, with support for parallel worktrees and remote sessions.

methods.name: showTerminal
methods.description: Displays or creates a terminal for a given session, setting the working directory based on session type and parallel mode.

methods.name: showOrCreateTerminal
methods.description: Creates a new terminal or shows an existing one for a session, handling terminal lifecycle and workspace directory.

methods.name: closeTerminal
methods.description: Closes and disposes of the terminal associated with a session.

methods.name: showExistingTerminal
methods.description: Reveals an existing terminal for a session if it is active.

methods.name: hasTerminal
methods.description: Checks if a session has an active terminal.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of all resources and optionally closes all terminals.
